rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on the northstar_retrieval knowledge_chunk and chunk_embedding tables, then drops chunk_embedding, knowledge_chunk, embedding_profile and the northstar_retrieval schema (CASCADE). All three tables are DERIVED projections over published knowledge content, so no authoritative data is lost; on a shared environment restore from the pre-migration backup and rebuild projections from published revisions instead.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
the pgvector extension is installable (CREATE EXTENSION vector)
postchecks: northstar_retrieval schema with embedding_profile, knowledge_chunk and chunk_embedding tables exists
knowledge_chunk has a GIN index on its tsvector column and chunk_embedding has a pgvector vector(256) column
row-level security is enabled and forced on knowledge_chunk and chunk_embedding with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: Phase 3 hybrid retrieval (FTS + pgvector exact) baseline
